facts.fact: Ghana News Agency reports President Mahama launched the National AI Strategy (2025-2035) in Accra on 24 April 2026, led by the Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations.

Government announced $250 million for an AI Computing Centre, with $20 million allocated for short- and medium-term implementation of the AI strategy, and plans a Responsible Artificial Intelligence Office to oversee implementation.
